args: const ask = suggest((t) => t + "?", 20); return await within(Promise.all([ask("c"), ask("ca")]));
const ask = suggest((t) => t + "!", 20); return await within(ask("hi"));
const ask = suggest((t) => t, 20); const a = await within(ask("x")); const b = await within(ask("y")); return [a, b];
let n = 0; const ask = suggest(() => ++n, 20); await within(Promise.all([ask(1), ask(2), ask(3)])); return n;
const p = suggest((t) => t, 30)("a"); const a = await Promise.race([p, wait(5).then(() => 0)]); return [a, await within(p)];
const ask = suggest(async (t) => t.toUpperCase(), 20); return await within(ask("ok"));
